title: Turkish Snapper Kisir
description: A refreshing and flavorful Turkish dish made with kisir, snapper, and herbs.

ingredients.name: with
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs (parsley, dill, or cilantro)

ingredients.name: herbs
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs (parsley, dill, or cilantro)

instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer to the oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix kisir, garlic, with, and herbs in a bowl.
Squeeze lemon juice over the kisir mixture and toss to combine.
Serve the baked snapper with the kisir mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional herbs if desired.
